method: Applied every repository migration, created a synthetic marker, used SQLite VACUUM INTO for the backup, copied it to a separate restore target, opened the restore read-only, and verified integrity, marker recovery, and required tables.
expectedRecoveryTime: Must be measured during a separately approved Cloudflare D1 recovery exercise before real-user launch.
limitations: This verifies the repository schema and an isolated backup/restore path only.
It does not authorize a destructive production restore.
It does not satisfy school or district privacy, retention, support, incident-response, roster-owner, or credential-delivery approval.
